rationale: The initial post-contingency state overloads branch l12. Of the four candidate single-switch actions, only closing branch l14 resolves this overload. Closing l14 provides an alternative path for power from bus 1 to bus 4, reducing the flow on l12 to 1.25 MW. The resulting network topology is connected, and all branch flows are within their emergency ratings. All other candidate actions result in a new overload or fail to resolve the existing one.
